author: Inside Edition
description: The national manhunt for famed actor and director Timothy Busfield is over. Busfield turned himself in to law enforcement in Albuquerque and vowed to fight child sex abuse charges. Police in New Mexico issued an arrest warrant alleging Busfield engaged in unlawful sexual conduct with twin brothers on the set of a TV show. Local police enlisted the aid of the US Marshals Service to track down the actor. Busfield is best known for his roles on the TV dramas “Thirtysomething” and "The West Wing.”
title: Actor Timothy Busfield Turns Himself In Amid Child Sex Abuse Charges

author: Inside Edition
description: The Westminster Mall in Orange County, California is in a state of ruins. When the mall opened in 1974, it was booming. At one point, the 9-acre mall had at least 168 stores. Today, there is graffiti, broken glass, and debris everywhere. The couches and chairs where exhausted shoppers once took a break have been destroyed. Police say they have been making at least 10 arrests a day. Donny Mohler shot some video of the mall. He spoke with Inside Edition.
title: Once-Bustling California Mall Now In A State Of Ruins

author: Inside Edition
description: Karen Read, acquitted of murdering her police officer boyfriend in a courtroom saga that transfixed America, says her life may be in danger. The 45-year-old former college professor spoke out in her first interview since her acquittal last summer. She said she is still struggling to rebuild her life. Read told the podcast Rotten Mango, that she felt depressed on the day of her acquittal. Read is planning to write a book with her lead defense attorney, Alan Jackson.
title: Karen Read Speaks Out In First Interview Since Acquittal

author: Inside Edition
description: Dr. Suzanne Pugh delivered Megan Lewis' first baby. After going through Lewis' old papers, it was discovered that letters dated 1994 and 1995 were signed "your pen pal, Suzanne Koziol." Lewis Googled the name and an image of Dr. Suzanne Koziol Pugh popped up. Turns out, the women were pen pals more than 30 years ago when Pugh was a 16-year-old high school junior and Lewis was a 7-year-old second grader.
title: Woman Discovers Her Childhood Pen Pal Delivered Her Kids

author: Inside Edition
description: Video captured a dramatic rescue of a parasailer who plopped down in the water off Palm Beach. Just released police bodycam footage shows officers racing to the rescue. The parasailer was flying a power-assisted paraglider above Singer Island when a sudden gust of wind slammed into him, tangling the cords of the chute in the blades of the motor. Brian Wenglarz, 52, plummeted 500 feet into the ocean. Wenglarz survived the incident.
title: Parasailer Survives Plummeting 500 Feet Into Ocean

author: Inside Edition
description: Andrea Yates drowned her five children, ages ranging from 6 months to seven years old, in a bathtub 25 years ago. Yates has been living in a mental facility in Texas since being found not guilty by reason of insanity. She claimed she suffered from a severe post-partum psychosis. Now, a new HBO Max documentary is raising questions. The documentary "The Cult Behind The Killer" shows Yate's es-husband, Rusty, today. Twenty-five years ago he was seen in court supporting his wife.
title: New Documentary Raises Questions About Andrea Yates Case

author: Inside Edition
description: Donkey's Place, a restaurant and bar in Camden, New Jersey, wants help finding an unusual, but beloved artifact the business has had for years. The walrus penis was allegedly taken by an Ohio man who visited with his two friends. It's one of two walrus penises the bar has, and it's part of a collection of unusual, but sentimental items that the family business has had for years. "We're not going out without a fight," bartender Mia Panella told Inside Edition Digital's Andrea Swindall.
title: New Jersey Bar Looking For Stolen Walrus Penis Artifact

author: Inside Edition
description: A brawl appeared to break broke out at a pee-wee hockey game in Hershey, Pennsylvania. The event was called "Mites On Ice," a face-off that took place during intermission at a minor league hockey game.
title: Was Kids Hockey Brawl Staged? #shorts

author: Inside Edition
description: It was a homecoming of sorts at Holloway High in Murfreesboro, Tennessee. Photos of students going back as far as the school's inception in 1932 now line the halls. Principal Sumatra Drayton says she knew there were composite drawings of the early graduating classes being kept at the local Elks Lodge, but she made it her mission to get them housed at Holloway. Inside Edition Digital’s Mara Montalbano has more.
title: Photos Of Students During Segregation On Display At High School

author: Inside Edition
description: Michael McKee has been charged with premeditated aggravated murder of dentist Spencer Tepe and his wife, Monique, in Columbus, Ohio.
title: Suspect Arrested In Killings Of Dentist And His Wife #shorts
